elements.element: Renewal is automatic for successive 12-month terms
elements.evidence: "This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms"

elements.element: Customer may opt out of renewal on 30 days' notice
elements.evidence: "Either Party may terminate this Agreement, or elect not to renew, for any reason following the Initial Term upon 30 days written notice"
"Kubient shall notify Customer 60 days before each renewal."

elements.element: Renewal price increases capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%
elements.evidence: "Renewal fees shall not increase more than the lesser of CPI and 3%."

elements.element: Non-renewal notice window no more than 60 days
elements.evidence: "upon 30 days written notice to the other Party"
"not increase more than the lesser of CPI and 3%"

reasons: All four atomic elements of the preferred automatic-renewal branch are expressly present: 12-month auto-renewal, a 30-day Customer non-renewal election, a 60-day Vendor pre-renewal reminder, and an uplift cap at the lesser of CPI and 3%.

Edits are surgical: one number change (90→30) plus the phrase 'or elect not to renew', and two short inserted sentences for the absent reminder and price cap; no whole-clause rewrite or new exceptions.

Untouched commercial terms (Initial Term, breach/insolvency termination, Kubient's entitlement to fees during the termination period) remain effective; no undefined terms or dangling mechanics introduced.
The fallback bargain is independently satisfied as well (≤60-day window, uplift below 5%).
